title: Robust Learning of Multi-Index Models under Logconcave Distributions via Weak Partial Learners
abstract: arXiv:2610.41961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a new algorithmic framework for learning Boolean concept classes under logconcave distributions. Our framework applies to broad families of multi-index models and yields significantly faster robust learners than were previously known in these settings. It extends to partial classification and testable learning. Consequently, we obtain improved learners for several fundamental concept classes, including functions of halfspaces and multiclass linear classifiers, under logconcave marginals.   Our starting point is a new boosting framework based on weak partial learners. Classical boosting approaches require often-intractable distribution-free weak learners or yield weak approximation guarantees. We show instead that weak learners for partial classification, where labels may be undefined on part of the domain, suffice for strong agnostic learning. translated_title: 基于弱部分学习器的对数凹分布下多指标模型的鲁棒学习
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个新的算法框架，用于在对数凹分布下学习布尔概念类。我们的框架适用于广泛的多指标模型族，并在这些设置下得到了比以往已知方法显著更快的鲁棒学习器。该框架还扩展到部分分类和可测试学习。因此，我们在对数凹边缘分布下为若干基本概念类（包括半空间函数和多类线性分类器）获得了改进的学习器。我们的出发点是一个基于弱部分学习器的新型提升框架。经典的提升方法要么需要通常难以实现的分布无关弱学习器，要么只能提供较弱的近似保证。我们则证明了，部分分类（即标签可能在域的一部分上未定义）的弱学习器足以实现强不可知学习。关键挑战在于，提升过程要求弱学习器在某种条件下成功，而（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于弱部分学习器的新型提升框架，使得在对数凹分布下能够对广泛的多指标模型实现显著更快的鲁棒学习，并由此改进了半空间函数和多类线性分类器等基本概念类的学习效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new boosting framework based on weak partial learners, enabling significantly faster robust learning of broad families of multi-index models under logconcave distributions and yielding improved learners for fundamental concept classes such as functions of halfspaces and multiclass linear classifiers.
